response.rationale: Multisystem autoimmune overlap with proximal myopathy, esophageal dysphagia, inflammatory sacroiliitis/arthritis, leukopenia, and thyroid autoimmunity is best explained by Mixed Connective Tissue Disease. JDM is contradicted by normal CK/EMG and absent rash; JIA does not explain myopathy/dysphagia; thyroid myopathy does not explain sacroiliitis/leukopenia; sarcoidosis lacks supporting systemic evidence.

rejected.why: Joint stiffness and sacroiliitis fit, but severe proximal weakness, dysphagia, and thigh muscle edema are unexplained; RF/CCP are negative.
Thyroid autoimmunity and hyperthyroid labs are present, but cannot account for sacroiliitis, hand joint inflammation, leukopenia, or thigh muscle edema.
Sacroiliitis and muscle edema are compatible, but there is no pulmonary/lymph node/calcium/ACE evidence and it less well explains leukopenia, thyroiditis, and ANA.
Proximal weakness, dysphagia, and muscle edema suggest it, but normal CK and EMG and absence of characteristic rash are strong contradictions.
